author: Xuph
body:
Hello this is my new map Limelight, helped by Koja:


Before you say anything, yes it was inspired from few aspects on Golden Drought 1 from ocn. 

Map features:

- Red vs Yellow
- Public gameplay purposed (16v16 would do)
- Gold supplies
- 2 Wools per team
- Defense supplies chest on wool lane
- Water in middle side islands
- 8 Iron blocks in middle
- Cool unique block palette ;)

NOTE: The soulsand in this map is solely for aesthetics and you won't be able to get soulsand drops for defense, it would disappear when mined.

Screenshots: http://imgur.com/a/5JfMX

Download: http://www.mediafire.com/file/eqp4ck9p6w5x35a/Eric2-ff9.zip

XML will be done soon, feedback is appreciated!
